title: Don (1978)
desc: Don, a gangster, dies during a police chase. Vijay, Don's lookalike, infiltrates his gang on DSP D'Silva's orders to gather information but a change of events lands him in trouble.

title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Kumki 2
desc: Bhoomi saves and raises a baby elephant, forming a deep bond before it vanishes. Years later, he ventures into the forest, hoping to reunite with his lost companion.

title: Dunki
desc: A group of friends risk everything to reach the UK through a dangerous route called 'donkey flight', facing life-threatening challenges and the harsh reality of illegal immigration.

title: Baaghi 4
desc: After a failed suicide attempt, a man struggles with reality as hidden truths and obsession blur his world, leaving his family in turmoil and his path tangled in love and mystery.

title: Socha Na Tha
desc: Viren cant imagine having an arranged marriage. His parents want him to meet Aditi. They refuse to get married but stay friends. Will Cupid strike and change their minds?

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Khudgarz
desc: Sita raises Bihari and Amar like brothers. But Amar's father dislikes Bihari and tries to create a rift, threatening their bond and Sita's peaceful family.

title: Apne Paraye
desc: Wealthy Sidheshwari hands over household control to her sister-in-law Sheila, but peace is soon threatened when Harish arrives with his cunning wife Naintara, who plots to manipulate her.

title: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
desc: City boy Ram falls for village girl Sona, raised by her strict brother Raghuveer. After Ram's mother insults Sona, Raghuveer challenges Ram to prove he's worthy of marrying her.

title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
desc: Akshay joins Maya's gang while searching for his missing brother. To earn her trust, he must prove his strength and defeat his rival in a wrestling match.

title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

title: Gadar 2
desc: Tara Singh goes missing during a skirmish and is believed captured in Pakistan. His son Jeete sets out to rescue him, plunging them into a deadly maze they must escape at all costs.

title: 2.0 Robot
desc: When mobile phones mysteriously fly from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and Nila investigate. To stop Pakshi Rajan's chaos, they must revive Chitti for a decisive battle.

title: Nill Battey Sannata
desc: Apeksha hates studying due to financial struggles. Her mother, Chanda, creates a clever plan to motivate her, turning resistance into ambition and learning into empowerment.
